scope: authorized finite repair of RIDE initialization/recharge/solver, then fresh fair CPOP comparison; no report or automatic CPOP substitution
generator: reuse independent fine-grid four-shape EV generator from prior mainline with fresh seeds/users; no inference-template generation in primary panel
reference: same past-only GBDT/prev10 selector with existing frozen model; no retraining, offset correction, oracle initialization or current response labels

changes: declared headroom rebound cap when device max supplied; ratio fallback if unknown
candidate.starts: fixed deterministic maximum5M1/6M2, including instant-edge branch; no search on test

fairness: all methods receive identical observed power, selected reference, task, sigma and declared EV max. Runtime may differ and is reported; old/revised RIDE compute budgets not claimed equal. Both old and repaired are compared to untouched CPOP.
primary_metric: event mean absolute error of cumulative task interval duration above0.1q, averaged by independent seed block; positive/zero equally weighted
secondary: no-action false detections with trueR0 denominator
gate_note: predeclared evidence rule for this limited panel; empirical error gates are not statistical5percent detection guarantees; no universal or realEV claim
source_freeze: development may repair at most2 targeted functional issues; final source frozen after validation and before any test generation/fit; test results never tune candidate
functional_controls: existing4M1/M2 exact controls plus delayed rebound with an internal gap, zero-response, zero-edge, amplitude-bound and solver-limit negatives; controls do not count as independent performance evidence
stress_after_freeze: new8usersx2events per testseed at20/37min sigma0.15, reported separately, no retuning
stop: one validation and one new test panel; if no stable advantage, retain results and ask user to decide future route, do not extend samples or switch beta until winning
